expected_primary_calls.note: All 23 Rye-AMR-primary samples are contained within the 38 FLARE-AMR-primary samples; the 15-sample gap is allele-frequency-driven boundary noise (EUR-leaning samples with non-trivial AMR).

interpretation: Soft proportions (mean per-ancestry mu) are the right comparison metric, NOT hard primary-call counts. Production runs on self-reported-Mexican subsets should show mean amr_mu >= 0.18 (the FLARE baseline) for an R21 pass.
